problem_statement: Our consumer applies account-update messages that the broker may redeliver or deliver out of order, each carrying a monotonically increasing sequence number per account. Applying the same message twice must not double-apply it — the second delivery is a no-op — and a message older than the newest applied sequence must be dropped, not applied, so a stale redelivery cannot resurrect an earlier balance. Today the consumer applies every message it receives: a redelivery double-counts the delta and an out-of-order older message rewinds the account. Track the newest applied sequence per account and apply a message only when its sequence is exactly the next one — gaps are held, not skipped.
